title: Appointed as Assistant
original: Hey, leader! Got some work for us?

title: Talk 1
original: Leader, how about we throw a party? We can play some hip-hop and eat apple pie. The best life is the party life! No party, no life!

title: Talk 2
original: Locked and loaded, ready for action! What's the objective today, Leader?

title: Talk 3
original: Some people believe money can buy anything. But, uh-uh, that saying doesn't really apply to me. Wealth won't make a lick of difference to where my targets end up.

title: Talk after Promotion 1
original: My first wish: more guns! We angels all have a patron firearm, a special gun we grow up with, but owning just one gun is kinda lame. I want eight more!

title: Talk after Promotion 2
original: My second wish: get someone to turn off this light over my head!

title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
original: I've always got Texas covered, that's why she lives so carefree. So obvious it goes without saying, right?

title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
original: If you ever run into an angel with black horns oozing ominous vibes, please tell her for me: I've never forgotten her.

title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
original: Us Penguin Logistics girls ain't so bad, right? What do you say, leader? Wanna come be our boss? Hehe, just kidding.

title: Idle
original: Oh Lord… is this another soul for us to save?

title: Onboard
original: Password: 'Long live the Penguin Empire.' So you're the client? Call me Exusiai. I'm nothing like that Lupo ice queen. I'm always down for some fun!

title: Watching Battle Record
original: I'm lovin' this feeling!

title: Promotion 1
original: Thanks for the promotion, leader.

title: Promotion 2
original: Leader... No, savior, I swear on this gun in my hand, I will protect you until the day of reckoning.

title: Added to Squad
original: Squad combat? I'm very familiar with that.

title: Appointed as Squad Leader
original: You've got a good eye. No one makes a better leader than me.

title: Depart
original: Let's go! Take them all by storm!

title: Begin Operation
original: Relax, I already called dibs on the most lucrative real estate in Hell, to share with all of you.

title: Selecting Operator 1
original: All right!

title: Selecting Operator 2
original: Is it my turn?

title: Deployment 1
original: Follow me!

title: Deployment 2
original: Let me double their trouble.

title: In Battle 1
original: Divine judgment!

title: In Battle 2
original: Rock n' roll!

title: In Battle 3
original: Barrage!

title: In Battle 4
original: Apple pie!

title: 4-star Result
original: Perfect! Let's keep up the momentum and charge on!

title: 3-star Result
original: May my hail of bullets bring you eternal peace.

title: Sub 3-star Result
original: Victory is a heavenly melody. Alright, let's go home and grab some beers!

title: Operation Failure
original: Life is like a gun, sometimes it just jams. Don't get discouraged, leader, we'll get'em next time.

title: Assigned to Facility
original: Wowee! I love this place!

title: Tap
original: Oh!

title: Trust Tap
original: Leader, wanna try out my weapon?

title: Title
original: Arknights.

title: New Year's blessing
original: Happy New Year, Leader! The party's about to start, Employee Performance Competition Night's over, and I'm not dead last! Here's your booze and apple pie. Let's heat ourselves up to the hip-hop beat, and set this firework tower to the sky~ Here we go! Three, two—BANG!

title: Greeting
original: Sup, leader!

title: Birthday
original: Leader, c'mere, c'mon! Welcome to your birthday party! Turn out the lights and blow out your candles! Oh, but remember, even as the candles go out, my halo will shine on you in the dark. Never worry that you'll lose your way—the angel's Blessings will be forever at your side.

title: Anniversary Celebration
original: We are led in differing directions. But by your power and wisdom, you may guide us on our journey together. Should the soul in you that protects us be a constant, we too will open a brand new path for you by our souls of honesty and ardor.
